ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between romance and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between family and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between money and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your image and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your career and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1816791004000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.
